committee: Presentation for Legislative Certificate No. 454-38 (LS) - Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
location: Public Hearing Room of the Guam Congress Building.
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 454-38 (LS), which recognizes Guam’s Veterans organizations on the occasion of Veterans Month 2026, and commends their dedication to preserving the legacy and service of Veterans to our island of Guam. The presentation is scheduled for Friday, October 30, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. in the Public Hearing Room of the Guam Congress Building.
